source: 2026-11-12: cluster_stretch 2.0 to 3.0 (owner: fields need to look longer); a pack is 3x longer along its orbit tangent but its radial reach is unchanged (11 map units across the orbit), so orbit clearance is as before: centres at most 264 from the sun plus the 34 long-axis reach is below 298, under the 328 and 351 orbits. 2026-11-07 T314: packs now travel the whole circle about the sun at the radius of their start position, so c1_2 moved from radius 298 to 210 (same direction) to stay clear of the dead_1 orbit (328; its pack reaches about 22 further out); no other pack touches a planet orbit (nearest planet orbits 328 in system 1 and 351 in system 2, packs end at 286). x, y are the position at game time zero. 2026-11-02 T156: cluster positions are map units (same as planets.json x,y), template values until T157 sees them on the map. Richness, yield and how many clusters are active come from balance.json: mining_cluster_richness, mining_yield_per_cycle, mining_clusters_s1, mining_clusters_s2 (the first N clusters of a system in this list are active). count = pack instances T157 draws at full richness; they thin as ore is taken. cluster_stretch = how many times longer a pack is along its orbit tangent than across the radius (owner 2026-11-04: 2.0). event_cluster = shape of the small cluster EV20 leaves when the player pays (richness: mining_event_cluster_richness).
